movies.title: Iron Man
movies.desc: Weapons manufacturer Tony Stark builds a powered suit of armor to escape captivity and becomes Iron Man. The first MCU film, introducing SHIELD and setting the shared universe in motion.
connections: Post-credits: Nick Fury introduces the Avengers Initiative

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.desc: Bruce Banner struggles to cure himself of the Hulk while pursued by General Ross. Connects to the broader universe via a Tony Stark cameo.
connections: Tony Stark cameo links to Iron Man 2

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.desc: Tony faces government pressure, a rivalry with Ivan Vanko, and his own health crisis. Introduces Black Widow and War Machine.

movies.title: Thor
movies.desc: The Asgardian prince Thor is banished to Earth and must prove himself worthy. Introduces the Nine Realms and cosmic elements to the MCU.

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.desc: Set in WWII, Steve Rogers becomes a super-soldier and defeats HYDRA's Red Skull. The Tesseract plays a central role.
connections: Tesseract links to Thor and The Avengers
Howard Stark links to Iron Man

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.desc: Earth's mightiest heroes unite to stop Loki and the alien Chitauri invasion. The culmination of Phase 1.
connections: Post-credits: Thanos revealed for the first time
Chitauri Scepter leads to Age of Ultron

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.desc: Tony battles anxiety after the events of The Avengers while a terrorist called the Mandarin emerges.
connections: Tony destroys all suits — but returns in Age of Ultron

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.desc: Thor must stop the dark elf Malekith from plunging the universe into darkness using the Aether, revealed to be an Infinity Stone.
connections: Post-credits: Guardians of the Galaxy teased with Collector

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
movies.desc: Steve Rogers uncovers a HYDRA conspiracy within SHIELD, while facing a mysterious assassin revealed to be his old friend Bucky Barnes.
connections: Mid-credits: Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver teased

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
movies.desc: A ragtag group of cosmic misfits team up to prevent the Power Stone from falling into the wrong hands.
connections: Power Stone appears in Infinity War

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.desc: Tony Stark creates Ultron, an AI peacekeeping program that turns against humanity. Introduces Scarlet Witch, Quicksilver, and Vision.
connections: Post-credits: Thanos gets the Infinity Gauntlet

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.desc: Master thief Scott Lang dons a powerful suit to pull off a heist with massive consequences. Introduces Pym Particles and the quantum realm.
connections: Quantum Realm key to time travel in Endgame

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.desc: The Avengers fracture over the Sokovia Accords. Black Panther and Spider-Man debut.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.desc: Neurosurgeon Stephen Strange discovers the mystic arts and becomes Earth's Sorcerer Supreme. Introduces the Time Stone.
connections: Kamar-Taj and the multiverse key to Multiverse of Madness

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
movies.desc: The Guardians discover the truth about Peter Quill's father Ego, a living planet.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.desc: Peter Parker balances high school life while proving himself as Spider-Man, mentored by Tony Stark.
connections: Iron Man mentorship critical in Endgame
Sets up Spider-Man in Infinity War

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.desc: Thor faces his sister Hela, the goddess of death, who destroys Mjolnir. He must escape Sakaar and save Asgard.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.desc: T'Challa returns to Wakanda to claim the throne, but faces a challenger in Erik Killmonger. Wakanda is revealed to the world.
connections: Wakanda central in Infinity War and Endgame

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.desc: Thanos collects all six Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life in the universe. Ends with the Snap.
connections: The Snap erases half of all life
Post-credits: Nick Fury activates Captain Marvel's pager

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
movies.desc: Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne team up to rescue Janet van Dyne from the quantum realm. Set simultaneously with Infinity War.
connections: Quantum Realm travel enables Endgame's time heist
Post-credits: Scott trapped during the Snap

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.desc: Set in the 1990s, Carol Danvers discovers her powers and past while helping the Skrulls.
connections: Post-credits: Carol responds to Fury's pager (links to Endgame)

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.desc: The surviving Avengers use time travel to collect the Infinity Stones and reverse the Snap. Tony Stark sacrifices himself. The definitive conclusion of the Infinity Saga.
connections: Iron Man dies — closes a 22-film arc
Steve passes shield to Sam Wilson

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.desc: Peter Parker goes on a school trip to Europe and is pulled into a new adventure with Mysterio. Deals with the aftermath of Endgame.
connections: Nick Fury is actually a Skrull

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.desc: Set between Civil War and Infinity War, Natasha confronts her past in the Red Room. Introduces Yelena Belova.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.desc: Shang-Chi confronts his father Wenwu and the ancient Ten Rings organization.
connections: Ten Rings organization finally revealed (from Iron Man 1)
Post-credits: Wong and Avengers analyze the Ten Rings

movies.title: Eternals
movies.desc: A group of immortal beings, hidden among humanity for thousands of years, reunite against the Deviants.
connections: Post-credits: Starfox (Thanos's brother) and Pip appear

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.desc: After his identity is revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. The spell goes wrong, pulling villains and Spider-Men from other universes into the MCU.
connections: Multiverse opens — central to Multiverse of Madness

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.desc: Strange travels through the multiverse with America Chavez, pursued by a corrupted Wanda Maximoff wielding the Darkhold.

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.desc: Thor searches for inner peace while Gorr the God Butcher targets all gods. Jane Foster wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor.
connections: Guardians leave — Thor on his own again

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.desc: Wakanda mourns King T'Challa and faces a new threat in the hidden underwater kingdom of Talokan, led by Namor. Shuri becomes the new Black Panther.
connections: Namor introduced — Talokan nation added to MCU

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
movies.desc: The Lang/Van Dyne family is sucked into the Quantum Realm and must face Kang the Conqueror, the central villain of the Multiverse Saga.
connections: Kang = main villain of Multiverse Saga
Post-credits: Council of Kangs, Victor Timely appears

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
movies.desc: The Guardians embark on a mission to save Rocket's life, revealing his tragic origins. An emotional farewell to the original team.
connections: Guardians disband — Rocket leads new team

movies.title: The Marvels
movies.desc: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau, and Kamala Khan swap places every time they use their powers.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.desc: Deadpool is recruited by the TVA and brings a reluctant Wolverine along on a multiverse-spanning mission. First R-rated MCU film.
connections: X-Men / Fox Marvel now officially in MCU

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.desc: Sam Wilson operates as the new Captain America and must stop a political conspiracy involving President Ross, who secretly becomes the Red Hulk.
connections: Thaddeus Ross returns as Red Hulk

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.desc: A team of anti-heroes assembled by Valentina face the enigmatic Bob Reynolds, the Sentry.
connections: Follows from Black Widow, Falcon & Winter Soldier

characters.name: Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch
films: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
characters.sceneFilm: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

characters.name: Stephen Strange / Doctor Strange
films: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
characters.sceneFilm: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

connections.title: The Avengers Initiative
connections.desc: Nick Fury recruits Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye across Phases 1-2. Each solo film builds toward The Avengers.

connections.title: Iron Man and Spider-Man
connections.desc: Tony Stark mentors Peter Parker across multiple films. Tony's death in Endgame drives Peter's arc in Far From Home and No Way Home.

connections.title: Thanos — The Infinity Saga
connections.desc: Thanos is foreshadowed as early as The Avengers (2012) and acts through proxies in multiple films before the climax of Infinity War and Endgame.

connections.title: The Tesseract / Space Stone
connections.desc: The Tesseract links Captain America, The Avengers, and Captain Marvel across decades of in-universe history.

connections.title: Captain America's Legacy
connections.desc: Steve Rogers hands the shield to Sam Wilson at the end of Endgame. Sam becomes Captain America in Brave New World.

connections.title: The Quantum Realm & Time Travel
connections.desc: Introduced in Ant-Man, expanded in Ant-Man and the Wasp, the Quantum Realm enables the time heist in Endgame. Returns in Quantumania.

connections.title: The Multiverse Opens
connections.desc: Doctor Strange, Loki, No Way Home, Multiverse of Madness, and Quantumania all fracture the multiverse, setting up the Multiverse Saga against Kang.
films: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

connections.title: Guardians of the Galaxy — Cosmic Family
connections.desc: The five Guardians appear across three solo films and both Avengers crossovers before disbanding in Vol. 3.

connections.title: Wakanda — From Secret to Open
connections.desc: First mentioned in Ultron, Wakanda becomes the site of the final battle in Infinity War and a global power by Wakanda Forever.

connections.title: HYDRA Within SHIELD
connections.desc: The Winter Soldier reveals HYDRA has been embedded in SHIELD since its founding in WWII, dissolving SHIELD entirely.

connections.title: Kang the Conqueror — The New Threat
connections.desc: Kang variants appear in Loki and Quantumania. The Council of Kangs positions the time-traveling conqueror as the overarching threat of the Multiverse Saga.

connections.title: The Black Widow Line
connections.desc: Natasha Romanoff's legacy continues through Yelena Belova, introduced in Black Widow and active in Thunderbolts*.
